meta.description: VAD agent team v26 — FIVE REAL-EVAL rounds (v196-v200), each ending in a genuine hard-88 A/B adjudication (NO smoke-only rounds). Committed pipeline = v137 + BUE + CBT + CBT-recal (all default-ON; hard-88 REF ~0.1105-0.1181, full-290 ~0.173). Every cheap recall direction is closed (frames v18, prompt v20/v177, granularity v182, text-embed v181, smoothing v184, dense substrate v185, spatial zoom v188, backbone v189, VideoMAE curves v190, VideoMAE learner v191, learned localizers v192-v195 research-closed on missing localized train supervision); Normal-FP video-level veto exhausted (v17/v21/v180/v186/v187); MIL level-signal family closed (v183). The five rounds attack what remains admissible: R1 v196 VLC — VLM video-level calibration (one extra whole-video VLM read v in [0,1] from 16 uniform frames; conf*=0.5+0.5v; the cross-video confidence-LEVEL oracle was +0.0518 and the MIL-signal variant v183 is closed but a VLM-READ signal is untested) — paired-log conf restore. R2 v197 DSV — dual-model second-opinion verification (each final detection window re-scored by the CLASSIFY client qwen3-vl-plus, a DIFFERENT model from the scan qwen-vl-plus; conf*=0.6+0.4a; <=8 calls/video cap) — paired-log conf restore. R3 v198 MCS — max-over-13-categories pointwise CLIP curve for the BUE/CBT boundary operators instead of the resolved-category curve (deterministic post-VLM, count+conf frozen) — paired-json pre_mcs_boundaries. R4 v199 FDS — frame-density scan: hard-cat-gated videos scan at 4fps (24 frames/6s segment, same placement, double density; v18 KFD varied placement at FIXED count, v182 varied window granularity — density is untested) — cross-run vs a FRESH in-session REF88. R5 v200 SVA — scan-verdict aggregate video level (zero new VLM calls: level = mean of top-3 scan-segment verdict confidences already in the pipeline; conf*=0.5+0.5*level) — paired-log conf restore. GATES loop1 hard-88 (all rounds): point_delta >= +0.008 AND P(delta>0) >= 0.9 AND new mAP >= 0.11306; FCCS==0 VOID check; FM2 det/video increase flagged > +1.0; M4 matched==n_fires / bad_videos empty for paired modes. Loop2 full-290 (only if loop1 passes): delta >= -0.003 AND abs >= 0.16454 AND Normal-FA rel increase <= +2%. Every round: implement flag default-OFF + 2-video self-test with an exact RESTORE-VERIFY (paired modes must reproduce the OFF arm byte-exactly before any 88-eval spend) + real 88-eval + records (summary + one ledger row). Round failure isolation: a failed round records and the next proceeds. Concurrency 2, never two evals (16 GB swap-thrash). NONE of the 10 banned families. Args: none.
